framework_metadata.description: 2x RTX 5090 (32 GB) layerwise-offload recipe -- the lightweight, broadly-runnable topology for this case.
framework_metadata.notes: Matches docs/cookbook/diffusion/MiniMax/MiniMax-H3.mdx's verified 2xRTX5090/32GB/377GiB-host recipe as-is. The recorded numbers below (612.65s/556.79s/23366MB) were captured 2026-08-07 on minimax-h3-5090-2gpu-v4 from a run that used --dit-offload-prefetch-size 0 instead of 1, chosen at the time because prefetch-size 1 had intermittently deadlocked at 'Loading MiniMaxH3DiTModel ... Run:ai Model Streamer' on a minority of launches. That deadlock's real cause turned out to be unrelated to prefetch-size -- LayerwiseOffloadManager.__init__ clamps prefetch_size to min(max(1, prefetch_size), num_layers), so 0 and 1 are runtime-identical, and the 0-vs-1 correlation was coincidence (page-cache warmth carried over across attempts). The actual root cause: runai_model_streamer issues an unconditional torch.distributed collective (new_group + all_gather_object) inside find_local_ranks() on the first stream_files() call per component per rank, regardless of the is_distributed argument sglang passes (always False here); any per-rank divergence in layerwise-offload load order or timing can call that ad-hoc group out of lockstep and hang. Fixed at the sglang layer in sgl-project/sglang#33969 (monkeypatches find_local_ranks to skip the collective) -- serve_args here now uses the cookbook's prefetch-size 1 since 0 was never actually load-bearing; re-validate this cell once that PR lands to confirm the hang no longer reproduces even under adversarial per-rank timing. Client wall 612.65s, server-reported inference_time_s 556.79, peak_memory_mb 23366 (well under the 32 GB budget). --performance-mode speed excluded: H3's compile path changes numerics, and speed mode's residency assumption does not fit 32 GB without the layerwise knobs above. Single-GPU (num_gpus=1, tp_size=1) at this exact shape (1344x768, 124 frames) OOMs even at resident-layers=20 -- TP2's per-rank activation footprint (measured ~13 GB/rank at 100% util during a real denoise) roughly doubles unsharded on 1 GPU, on top of a 32 GB card already near its edge per the cookbook's own 2-GPU peak (~31.7 GiB/rank); the case is 2-GPU-only until that's independently reworked.
framework_metadata.serve_args: --model-type diffusion --warmup-mode server --model-variant fl2va --tp-size 2 --ulysses-degree 1 --performance-mode memory --layerwise-offload-components dit,text_encoder,vae --dit-offload-prefetch-size 1 --dit-layerwise-resident-layers 20 --enable-torch-compile false
